statement: Information is the primary represented substrate in this project's modeling framework. Energy drives permissible change over terrain through elapsed time, producing a system state.
equation: S(t + dt) = F_theta(S(t), I(t), E(t), T(t), dt; seed)
scope: An explicit modeling contract, not a demonstrated universal physical law or a claim that biological and quantum scales share one dynamics model.

fields.information: What the system encodes and what an agent can sense or communicate; declare representation and locality.
fields.energy: What permits state change; declare units, supplied budget, consumption, dissipation and unresolved terms.
fields.terrain: Spatial and contextual constraints: geometry, barriers, gradients, media and boundary conditions.
fields.time: Declared integration step and observation horizon. Simulation units do not automatically map to physiological time.
fields.system_state: Observable outputs plus internal state, uncertainty, provenance, model version and random seed.

implemented_adapters.schooling: Local positions/headings; finite normalized movement budget; periodic terrain with optional mobility band; bounded time horizon; exported positions, velocities, energy ledger and polarization.
implemented_adapters.crossing: Specified vesicle/repair parameters; conservative tissue transport and compartments; assumed 10-second clock. No explicit metabolic energy budget: this term remains unresolved.
implemented_adapters.epoch4: Existing information-primary tissue operators in sim/epoch4; not numerically coupled to the schooling or Crossing solvers.
implemented_adapters.tensor_network: Conditional angle features and Born-normalized fate outputs; computational surrogate, not a quantum energy/terrain solver.

coupling_contract: Any future scale transfer must identify source and target state, units, mapping, conserved quantities, uncertainty, timing and supporting evidence. No implicit conversion from fish behavior to cell biology.
